_doc: Demo groups: one desktop folder and one RasQberry menu submenu each (Quantum Demos), and one heading on the website's demo list. Read by rq_desktop_session.py (desktop), rq_demo_generate_menu.sh (menu cache) and scripts/generate-demo-list.js on gh-pages. A demo's group is the 'group' of its manifest; a catalogue demo's comes from its known-demos.json entry, else its manifest, else a guess (LED panel demos: led-panel; game or visualization: play; else learn). Fields: groups (in this order): id (a manifest's group value), title (folder and submenu name), menu (one line after the title in the menu), description (one line for the website), icon (file in desktop-icons/, installed to /usr/share/icons/rasqberry/). starters: launchers that are also loose on the desktop (they stay in their folders too; small screens drop them from the desktop first, last one first). system: loose launchers that are no demo. launchers: desktop launchers without a manifest and their group (null: loose only).
